tables.title: E5a/b. Value of reading the rival (wiosenna)
tables.measured: Same `best` deck for both sides (one veteran collection per pair, the default budget), both seats. omniscient is handed the rival's actual plan each round; exploiter repeats the deterministic planner's reasoning on 3 guessed planner hands and answers the 3 predicted plans. planner vs greedy repeated here for comparison.

tables.title: E5c. How often reading changes the plan (wiosenna)
tables.measured: E1 matches (planner vs planner, own veteran collections), N = 1000 matches: share of planner decisions whose chosen plan is not the plan greedy would play (the best plan if the rival did nothing).
rows: Planner plan differs from greedy plan
